name: Content, dictionary entry
description: A word set like a dictionary entry, with pronunciation, part of speech, numbered meanings and an origin note.

default.meaning: A short record written in the moment, while the thing you are observing is still happening.
default.example: Her field notes from the warehouse visit said more than the survey did.

default.meaning: A clip of a customer conversation, tagged and shared so the whole team hears the same thing.
default.example: Drop the fieldnote in the planning doc before Thursday.

default.meaning: Informal. Proof that a decision came from a customer, not a hunch.

fields.name: origin
fields.label: Origin
fields.default: From anthropology, where researchers wrote field notes by hand. Borrowed by a Toronto team in 2019 who wanted the same closeness without the notebook.
